styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Bondi, Coogee and a ferry to Manly.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: The Rocks, the Opera House and the harbour museums.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Coastal walks, harbour ferries and the Blue Mountains.

stays.why: Old sandstone lanes, weekend markets and a short walk to the Opera House and Circular Quay ferries.
Best base for first-timers: ferries, trains and the harbour icons on your doorstep.
Family-friendly: aquarium, maritime museum and flat walks; light rail and buses nearby.
Beach mornings and the coastal walk; 20–30 minutes by train and bus to the centre.

food: Try a flat white and a meat pie or a lamington for a cheap daytime bite.
Seafood by the water: fish and chips at Watsons Bay or Manly, or the Sydney Fish Market.
Asian food is excellent and good value: Chinatown, Haymarket and the Spice Alley laneway.
Book ahead for dinner in Surry Hills and Newtown; walk-ins are easier at lunch.
Alcohol is sold in bottle shops and licensed venues; many cafés stop serving coffee early afternoon.
more_time: Swap a beach day for the Blue Mountains: train from Central (about 2 hours each way) to Katoomba for the Three Sisters and bush walks.
Take the ferry to Taronga Zoo for harbour views and a half-day with animals.
Walk the Bondi to Coogee coastal path (about 6 km, 2 hours) and swim at the beaches along the way.

recommend.why: Three nights covers the harbour icons, a beach day and a coastal walk without rushing; add a night for the Blue Mountains.

month_notes: January: hottest month, highs near 27°C and 13 rain days. Book beaches early and carry water.
February: warm and similar to January, around 26°C with 13 rain days.
March: still warm at 25°C but rainier, about 15 rain days. Keep a light rain jacket.
April: mild and drier, highs near 22°C with 10 rain days. Good for walking and coastal paths.
May: cooler at 19°C and only 8 rain days. Bring a layer for evenings.
June: winter starts, highs near 17°C and 10 rain days. Pack a warm jacket.
July: coldest month, highs near 17°C and lows around 8°C. Driest stretch with 7 rain days.
August: similar to July, 18°C highs and only 6 rain days. Crisp, clear days for walks.
September: warming to 21°C with 8 rain days. A pleasant shoulder month.
October: mild at 22°C but rain picks up to 11 days. Carry an umbrella.
November: warm at 24°C with 11 rain days. Good for beaches and ferries.
December: warm and busy, 26°C highs and 10 rain days. Book accommodation well ahead.

climate_guide.summary: Warm temperate climate: mild winters, warm summers and rain spread through the year. Rarely very cold or very hot.

items.title: Best time: December to March
items.text: Warmest months, highs 25–27°C. Best for beaches and harbour days, but also the busiest and priciest.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Rain days run from 6 to 15 a month. March is wettest; August is driest. Showers often pass quickly.

items.title: Mild winters (June to August)
items.text: Highs around 17–18°C and lows near 8–9°C. Bring a warm layer; beach swims are for the brave.

items.title: Sea and sun
items.text: Summer sun is strong; use sunscreen and shade. Check flags and surf conditions at patrolled beaches.

items.title: Pack for changeable days
items.text: A light rain jacket and layers work in every month. Evenings cool down near the water.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: T-shirts and shorts for summer, a jumper and jacket for winter, comfortable walking shoes and a hat.

transit.best: Opal card or contactless tap for trains, ferries and buses; ferries are the scenic way to cross the harbour.

modes.text: Trains, metro and light rail run on one Opal card or contactless tap. Fast way in and out of the CBD.
Ferries from Circular Quay are the scenic way to reach Manly, Taronga Zoo and Watsons Bay.
Buses fill the gaps in the inner suburbs. Google Maps and TripView show live times.
Taxis and Uber, DiDi and Ola all operate. Taxis are easiest at ranks and the airport.
Driving is busy and tolled on most motorways. Parking in the centre is costly.
The CBD is walkable. Bikes and e-scooters suit the harbour foreshore paths.
